prompt.text:
Implement `buildRequestDescriptor(baseUrl, endpoint, options, token)` and export it directly with `module.exports`.

This pure function builds a deterministic request description without performing I/O. `baseUrl` must be a non-empty string and `endpoint` must begin with `/`. Trailing slashes are removed from `baseUrl` before concatenation. `options` may be omitted and otherwise must be a non-array object. Its `method` defaults to `GET` and is case-insensitive, but only `GET` and `POST` are allowed. Its optional `headers` must be a non-array object whose values are strings.

The result is `{ url, method, headers, body }`. Headers are copied into a fresh object, `Content-Type` is always forced to `application/json`, and a non-empty string token adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token may otherwise be `null` or `undefined`; other token values are malformed. GET forbids an own `body` property and returns `body: null`. POST requires an own `body` property and returns its JSON serialization. Values that JSON cannot serialize to a string must cause `TypeError`. Unsupported methods cause `RangeError`; all malformed inputs cause `TypeError`. Inputs must not be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
